What is most disturbing is that PRs, bouncers, and even one of the owners present at the time witnessed everything and chose to do nothing. They simply stood there and watched.

Let’s be honest — if such language had been used toward your sister or girlfriend, it would never have been tolerated. Stand for the truth.

The environment felt unsafe, unprofessional, and deeply disrespectful, especially for paying guests celebrating a private occasion. My birthday was completely ruined, and I will never recommend this place.

Public note:
Next time, boys and men — please wear sandos (ganjis) 😍
Apparently, this is the only club in Mumbai that proudly entertains men in innerwear 🤣🤣🤣🤣

Despite all this, there was not even a single apology. The PR (J*Y), who was never present to check on guest safety or comfort, suddenly appeared at billing time demanding cash.

PR J*Y and the owner present that night — after witnessing the abuse and repeated complaints, no one took a stand for the truth.

featured_reviews.name: Jay Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star

Extremely disappointing experience at Game Palacio Bandra. We booked a table for 8 people on a Saturday night by paying an advance amount through their PR, Jay, who assured us that we would get a bowling lane at 10:30 PM and specifically asked us to arrive accordingly. We reached at 10:35 PM—just 5 minutes late—and despite informing him and paying in advance, he told us that our lane had already been given away and that they could no longer assure us anything. This completely ruined our plans.

The worst part was that Jay made promises just to sell us the table and then failed to honor any of his commitments. We were willing to wait and stayed until closing time, but nobody followed up with us regarding bowling or provided any proper resolution.

There was also no prior communication that table service was restricted to bottle purchases only. After spending nearly ₹25,000, we were given a cramped table under the staircase where our heads were literally touching the stairs. Only after repeatedly requesting the manager and PR were we allowed to order beers and cocktails.

To make matters worse, a service charge of nearly ₹3,000 was added to the bill and was not removed despite multiple requests. We were incorrectly told it was mandatory, which is not in line with current government guidelines regarding service charges.

The venue also shut around 1:10 AM despite being told it would remain open until at least 1:30 AM. Overall, terrible customer service, false commitments, poor management, and a complete waste of a Saturday night. There are far better places in Bandra to spend your money. Game Palacio should be your last choice.

featured_reviews.name: Princess Ifeanyi Williams
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located in the heart of downtown, vgs gaming cafe is a haven for gamers and tech enthusiasts alike. As a frequent visitor, I’m excited to share my experience and thoughts on this standout spot.

Atmosphere: 4.5/5
The moment you step into vgs esports, you’re greeted by an inviting, modern aesthetic. The décor is a blend of sleek, industrial design with vibrant, gaming-themed accents that make you feel like you’re inside your favorite game. The lighting is adjustable, allowing you to switch between bright and ambient settings depending on your mood and the time of day. Comfortable seating is available, from plush couches to ergonomic gaming chairs, ensuring you can play for hours without discomfort.

Gaming Setup: 5/5
vgs gaming boasts an impressive array of gaming stations, each equipped with the latest high-end PCs, consoles, and VR setups. The hardware is top-notch, with fast processors, high-resolution monitors, and a variety of peripherals to suit any gaming style. The café offers a wide selection of games, from popular AAA titles to indie gems, and the staff is knowledgeable about the latest releases and updates.

Service: 4.5/5
The staff at Vgs gaming are friendly and attentive, always ready to assist with any issues or questions. They’re well-versed in both gaming and the café’s menu, which helps when navigating the extensive list of games and snacks. The occasional wait for peak hours is the only minor hiccup, but the staff’s efficiency and positive attitude make it a minor inconvenience.

Community and Events: 4/5
Vgs gaming regularly hosts gaming tournaments, themed nights, and social events, creating a vibrant community atmosphere. These events are well-organized and attract a diverse group of gamers, fostering a sense of camaraderie. However, during these events, the space can get crowded, which might detract from the experience for those seeking a quieter environment.

Pricing: 4/5
The pricing is reasonable for the quality and variety offered. Gaming stations are charged by the hour, with competitive rates that are in line with other gaming cafés in the area. Food and drink prices are also fair, though some may find the cost of premium gaming setups and snacks a bit steep. There are occasional promotions and membership deals that offer good value, making it worth keeping an eye out for those.

Overall: 4.5/5
Vgs Gaming Café is a standout destination for gamers looking for a comfortable, high-quality environment to indulge their hobby. With its excellent gaming setups, welcoming atmosphere, and strong community spirit, it’s a must-visit for anyone passionate about gaming. While there’s always room for improvement, particularly in the speed of food service and managing peak hours, the overall experience is highly satisfying. Whether you’re a casual gamer or a serious enthusiast, Vgs gaming is definitely worth checking out.
